messages:
maya: Heads-up: seeing a cluster of reconnects this morning tied to quarantine routing. clients get 200 then immediate socket close and a reconnect loop :grimacing:
sam: Any error logs from the proxy or edge?
maya: Proxy shows "session quarantined: route-age > max_idle" then a 204 to client. snippet:
```
proxy: session 0x7f3a quarantined route_age=3605s -> choosing fallback-route
proxy: client_conn 203.0.113.7 -> backend eu-west-1c closed (early-close)
```
jorge: 204 earlier? that sounds like the proxy is doing a fast-fail to avoid stuck sockets. Why are clients reconnecting so quickly?
alex: We recently reduced client backoff in the JS SDK to 1s -> exponential. Could be making the loop visible.
liz: Console traces show these requests attributed to the new canary routing policy (route-weight hot-swap). sampling is 1% so dashboards look fine, but the actual per-route timeline is missing.
maya: Right — telemetry only sampled a tiny fraction and our per-route SLO alerts didn't fire. need better sampling or a low-overhead counter.
sam: Is this the same path where resume tokens get dropped? We had that bug with opaque headers last quarter.
jorge: Not identical: here the quarantine decision happens before resume validation. I think a TTL mismatch between route-manager and pool-allocator.
ops-bot: incident:detected quarantine-spike service=proxy scope=eu-west-1c count=462 duration=00:12:17
devex: For the SDK change, can we add a small randomized jitter to avoid synchronized retries? even +50-500ms would help.
alex: Agreed. I'll PR a jitter and increase the initial backoff to 500ms.
maya: Parallel ask: console UX — can we add a tiny timeline that shows recent route-age/skew buckets per tenant (cheap hist counts)? current dashboard only shows aggregate reconnects.
liz: I'll prototype a stacked small-metric viz (route_age_buckets) and attach to route detail. low-cardinality, should be safe.
sam: Also we should log a distinct metric when proxy emits 204-for-quarantine vs normal 204. right now they collapse.
jorge: I can add label quarantine=true on that code path. We'll need a short rollout to avoid metric explosion.
ops-bot: deploy:proxy/quarantine-204-label rolled out to canary (5%) at 11:18UTC
maya: After canary we saw a 70% drop in fast-reconnect loops for that tenant. looks promising.
devex: Nice. follow-up: add a short note in SDK changelog about backoff change and recommend customers bump client's jitter if they run heavy fanout.
alex: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/pulls/422 — includes jitter and initial-backoff bump + tests
liz: I'll add the new route_age visualization to console canary tomorrow and link it in the deploy notes.
maya: Thanks team. next steps: (1) merge SDK jitter PR, (2) roll metric-label to 50%, (3) console viz canary. I'll open tickets. :thumbsup:
